statusReason: Eight standalone AV application candidates from #285-#292 are merged through #293 and published at 59d41e3 after release repairs #294-#295. Source and AV destination deployment, isolated live desktop/phone Toolbox journeys, theme checks, Rail behavior and asset parity passed. All eight new Rail console slots remain Planned. Canonical specialist handoffs and representative app parity remain incomplete; physical/operator acceptance, Stream/Record and universal app management are separate open work.
shipped: All six viewport candidates delivered across 20 routes: Calculator, shared navigation, 12 Show Operations tools, Cue Sheet, five Logistics tools and StagePlotter (#237–#243).

Application Rail (#272, #274, #276, #279): shared runtime/dialogs and typed Toolbox commands are mounted around AV Video with nine RAIL-1B slots, eight Planned entries, RAIL-2A breakpoints, device-local customization and offline support. Source/destination publication, Walter live acceptance, seven-asset parity and the returning-client cache transition from published adf1f1e to reviewed 55bec1a passed.
AV Video Manage modules (#283): the Toolbox card opens the guarded Project view; source and AV publication, Walter live navigation/browser checks and four-asset parity passed at a6241a9.

Eight standalone AV application candidates (#285-#293) are published at 59d41e3 after release repairs #294-#295. Walter passed 16 isolated live Toolbox journeys, light/dark checks at phone and desktop widths, Rail and Calculator/Show Control flows; all eight new Rail console slots remain Planned.
